643-3277-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-3277-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

2510-4399-4518--228.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-4399-4518--228.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Semblance Anvil.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2510-4399-4518--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3661-3899-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
3661-3899-5006-8170.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Shield Sphere, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

413-7084-8293.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

4247-7084-8293.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

240-2079-5470-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-2079-5470-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

4770-6090-6723-7175.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

728-1887-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
728-1887-5254.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

3490-7075-7297-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-7075-7297-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

728-856-1379-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

62-833-3478-3827.notablePrerequisites:
Soul of Windgrace can attack without taking damage.
Savage Ventmaw can attack without taking damage.
62-833-3478-3827.description:
Declare Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding six mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Dimir Aqueduct, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1429-3545-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1339-2122-4050-7803.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-4050-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
1339-2122-4050-7803.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {1}.
Repeat.

862-3558-5049-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-3558-5049-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1636-4258-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-4258-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

874-1170-1329-5434.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-5434.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

618-2633-4456-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {2}{R} due to Urabrask.
Urabrask and Hematite Talisman trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Hematite Talisman trigger, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2445-3099-4565-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Ozolith, the Shattered Spire and Branching Evolution.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2528-5088-5686-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2528-5088-5686-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Channel the Suns with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Channel the Suns from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve both copies of Channel the Suns, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Channel the Suns.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 15.

4186-5070-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-5070-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3175-5147-5617.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

423-433-1437-3478--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-433-1437-3478--85.description:
Cast Llanowar Scout by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Llanowar Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Llanowar Scout copy.
Activate the Llanowar Scout token by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-3499-3581-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3499-3581-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

1849-2203-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1849-2203-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

64-500-1777.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Warden of the Eye and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Warden of the Eye tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a Warden of the Eye token, adding {B}{B} plus an additional amount of {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2. 
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

5223-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1495-1887-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Vorinclex.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-1887-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

3821-4477-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
3821-4477-6485.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Greenwarden of Murasa and Peregrine Drake, targeting Greenwarden of Murasa
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Greenwarden of Murasa and Peregrine Drake tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

2034-2281-5925.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jackdaw Savior, adding {C}{C}.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2198-2440-3263-4183.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
2198-2440-3263-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Deceiver Exarch with haste.
When the token Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Deceiver Exarch trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Deceiver Exarch.
Repeat.

304-1978-2364.description:
Animate Mana Vault using Tough Cookie.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-2366-2757-5702.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Dryad Arbor.
1308-2366-2757-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control at least one basic Forest, or the land card in your hand is a basic Forest.
1308-2366-2757-5702.description:
Play any land from your hand, ensuring to play a basic Forest if you have one in hand.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Dryad Arbor token, untapping the basic Forest.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 one additional time.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 3.

3489-3542-5262.notablePrerequisites:
Throat Slitter does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{B}{B}.
3489-3542-5262.description:
Declare Throat Slitter as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Throat Slitter from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Throat Slitter's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{B} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Throat Slitter onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

703-1622-3129.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Minion Reflector trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Primal Vigor that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Minion Reflector trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens with haste.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Primal Vigor tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

500-3858-4365-4751.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power 3 or greater.
500-3858-4365-4751.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, putting sixteen +1/+1 counters on a creature you control with power 3 or greater.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

539-1636-3558-5094-5196.notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
539-1636-3558-5094-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Crookshank Kobolds to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If you control another nontoken creature without summoning sickness, this combo nets infinite mana creatures you control can produce.

1407-1806-2034-4853.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Dollhouse of Horrors by paying {1}, tapping it and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it that is a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
The Eternal Scourge dies, triggering Dross Scorpion, untapping Dollhouse of Horrors.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

1834-2882-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
1834-2882-4675-4694.description:
Cast Briber's Purse by paying {0}.
Briber's Purse enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Briber's Purse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

522-1657-2292-2890-4583.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Protean Hulk to die.
522-1657-2292-2890-4583.description:
Get Protean Hulk killed, triggering its ability.
Get Body Snatcher and Viscera Seer.
With Body Snatcher's ETB trigger on the stack, sacrifice it to Viscera Seer, getting back Protean Hulk for its death trigger.
Sacrifice Hulk to Viscera Seer, triggering its ability.
Get Murderous Redcap and Melira.
Murderous Redcap ETB ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Sacrifice Murderous Redcap to Viscera Seer, bringing it back with persist.
Melira prevents a -1/-1 counter from being put on Murderous Redcap.
Repeat.
